Fox Point Capital Management Has Trimmed Its Facebook (FB) Stake; CONCERT PHARMACEUTICALS (CNCE) Has 2.62 Sentiment
May 18, 2018 - By Richard Conner
CONCERT PHARMACEUTICALS (CNCE) investors sentiment increased to 2.62 in 2017 Q4 . It’s up 1.44, from 1.18 in 2017Q3. The ratio is positive, as 76 funds increased or opened new equity positions, while 29 cut down and sold stakes in CONCERT PHARMACEUTICALS. The funds in our database now possess: 15.49 million shares, up from 14.57 million shares in 2017Q3. Also, the number of funds holding CONCERT PHARMACEUTICALS in top ten equity positions decreased from 2 to 1 for a decrease of 1. Sold All: 10 Reduced: 19 Increased: 34 New Position: 42.
Fox Point Capital Management Llc decreased Facebook Inc (FB) stake by 33.33% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. Fox Point Capital Management Llc sold 12,500 shares as Facebook Inc (FB)’s stock declined 14.10%. The Fox Point Capital Management Llc holds 25,000 shares with $4.41 million value, down from 37,500 last quarter. Facebook Inc now has $528.79B valuation. The stock decreased 0.59% or $1.08 $182.68. It discovers and develops novel small molecule drugs for use in the treatment of various pulmonary diseases, including cystic fibrosis, autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, and central nervous systems disorders. It has a 5.04 P/E ratio.
